concept.name: Step Change in a Figure
concept.description: A figure that moves from one settled level to another in a move with a definite start and finish, holds the new level, then moves back in a second definite move.
concept.scope_note: WHAT IS QUANTIFIED: the level of ONE measured figure over time (a price, rate, total, count, index), described by direction and size of change from its starting level. It is NOT 'how much / how many' (countable vs uncountable), NOT comparison between two things (-er / more than) and NOT sufficiency (enough / too). Those are separate cards.
concept.shape: Stepped change, reversible (distinct start and finish to each move)
concept.notes: GT5L because each move has a distinct beginning and end (e.g. a rate raised on a set date); contrast B1 (GTCV). Lines 1/3/5 = settled levels, lines 2/4 = the two moves. Line 1+ / Line 3+ carry reference-level words.
